Package arztis.econnector.rest

Class ElgaConnectionCaller

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.ElgaConnectionCaller
public class ElgaConnectionCaller
extends java.lang.Object
JAVA API for the ELGA reference client. This class includes all function calls that are required for
  • Reading the cards (e-card and Admin-Card - GINA)
  • User registration for ELGA and GINA
  • Patient contact confirmation with e-Card and bPK
  • Retrieving documents from ELGA and their eHealth applications such as the electronic immunization record or the virtual organizations
  • Posting and register documents in ELGA areas for different services such as the electronic immunization record or the eMedication
  • Canceling documents in ELGA areas for different services such as the electronic immunization record or the eMedication
  • Retrieving the ID for eMedication (eMed-Id)
  • Retrieving demographic patient data
  • List and cancel patient contacts
This class is built as singleton, so you have to call getInstance() to instantiate.
Author:
ET-Innovations

    • registerPatientContact

      public java.lang.Object registerPatientContact​(ConnectionData connData, PatientContactParameter contactParameter)
      This method first retrieves the card token form the inserted e-Card. Afterwards the identity assertion is requested by the SVC with the respective card token. The identity assertion is sent to all ELGA areas, which are enabled in the configuration file.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to insert the contact confirmation
      contactParameter - contains details like the used card reader to register the contact confirmation
      Returns:
      If the contact confirmation was successfully submitted, true is returned. Otherwise false or an error message Message is returned.

    • registerUser

      public java.lang.Object registerUser​(ConnectionData connData, RegisterParam registerUserParam)
      This method first retrieves the card token form the inserted Admin-Card. Afterwards the identity assertion is requested by the SVC with the respective card token. With the identity assertion an HCP assertion is requested from ELGA. If a context assertion is needed for the ELGA application like for the electronic immunization record, the context assertion will be requested with the appropriate HCP assertion. All assertions are stored in the parameter connData.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to register the user
      registerUserParam - contains details for the user registration
      Returns:
      If the user was registered successfully, the filled connection data object connData is returned. If the registration failed, false or an error message Message is returned.

    • requestIdaGdaHospital

      public java.lang.Object requestIdaGdaHospital​(RequestIdaParameter requestIdaParameter)
      This method requests an identity assertion from the ELGA area with the give parameter requestIdaParameter.
      Parameters:
      requestIdaParameter - contains details for the IDA request
      Returns:
      If the request was successful, the identity assertion as xml is returned. If the requestIdaParameter is null, null is returned. If the request failed an error message Message is returned.

      public java.lang.Object logOffUser​(ConnectionData connData)

    • findPrescriptions

      public java.lang.Object findPrescriptions​(ConnectionData connData, SearchParameter searchParam, boolean forDispenses)
      This method queries open prescriptions, if forDispenses is true. Otherwise it queries all prescriptions of a patient.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to retrieve the prescriptions
      searchParam - contains details for the restriction of the prescription search such as social security number of the patient
      forDispenses - parameter to limit the search for open or all prescriptions. True if only prescriptions to be dispensed should be requested. Otherwise false.
      Returns:
      If the user was registered successfully and prescriptions were found, AdhocQueryResponseDocument is returned. If the query failed, the error message Message, why the request failed is returned.

    • generateUpdateImmunizationEntry

      public java.lang.Object generateUpdateImmunizationEntry​(java.lang.String json, java.lang.String userId)
      This method generates an instance of EimpfDocumentUpdateImmunisierungsstatus in the ehealth connector project. This instance can be used to generate the XML of the CDA document. The instance is filled with the information form the json
      Parameters:
      json - data of the CDA document in json form. The description of the detailed json structure could be found under docs/api/v1/cda.md in the section generate "Update Immunisierungsstatus"
      userId - id of the user who wants to generate the CDA document. If this parameter is null, then the userId is read from the specified json
      Returns:
      if the request was successful EimpfDocumentUpdateImmunisierungsstatus is returned, otherwise an error message Message is returned.
